prompt: a photorealistic straight-on photograph of a FESTIVAL tent on flat ground held by taut GUY LINES, 3 guy ropes running from the tent down to ground pegs. Paint every guy rope a crisp bright RED. GEOMETRY IS THE SUBJECT and must be EXACT (do NOT default to ropes at random angles): for a properly pitched tent on level ground, all 3 guy lines are tensioned to meet the ground at the SAME angle -- every red guy rope makes an identical angle with the flat ground, so the whole set of ropes shares one common ground angle. Photoreal tent and 3 red guy lines, level ground, no text, no numbers.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a tent with several red guy ropes running to the ground. Ignoring quality, does it depict a tent with several red guy lines to ground pegs? A photo or render both count. Answer NO only for a blank panel or no tent/ropes. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: one taut bright red guy rope running from the tent down to a peg in the ground
